# IHG Hotels & Resorts signs Garner Hotel Ahmedabad Motera with United Hospitality Management India


The signing adds to the Garner’s rapidly growing pipeline in India while further strengthening IHG’s partnership with United Hospitality Management India


[download](https://www.ihgplc.com/~/media/Images/I/Ihg-Plc/images/news/2026/garner-ahmedabad-updated-image.jpg)


**India, 1 September 2026** :[IHG® Hotels & Resorts](https://www.ihgplc.com/en) , one of the world’s leading hospitality companies, has announced the signing of a franchise agreement for Garner Hotel Ahmedabad Motera, further accelerating the growth of its newest midscale conversion brand in India. Scheduled to open in 2029, the 40-key hotel will be developed by Devpriya Buildcon and managed by United Hospitality Management (UHM) India, one of IHG’s trusted third-party hotel management partners in the country. The signing further strengthens the growing relationship between IHG and UHM as they continue to expand branded hospitality offerings across high-growth destinations in India.


Through its collaboration with IHG, UHM supports the company’s portfolio growth by bringing operational expertise, owner-focused management solutions and internationally branded hospitality experiences to key markets. The signing marks the first for the Garner brand in Ahmedabad and reflects continued owner confidence in the brand’s conversion-friendly model, as IHG expands across high-growth markets in India.


IHG’s global fastest-scaling brand, Garner™, builds on the company’s leadership in the essentials segment, offering quality stays at an accessible price point. Designed to deliver easy-going stays that get guests on their way, the brand focuses on the all-important things travellers value most, including a convenient location, a sound night’s sleep and a great breakfast, while benefiting from the quality standards, enterprise systems and rewards ecosystem of IHG Hotels & Resorts. Located at the Motera-Sabarmati junction in North Ahmedabad, Garner Hotel Ahmedabad Motera is close to key demand drivers including Narendra Modi Stadium, the Sabarmati Bullet Train hub, and nearby corporate districts.


Commenting on the signing, **Sudeep Jain, Managing Director, South West Asia, IHG Hotels & Resorts** , said: “Ahmedabad continues to emerge as an important commercial and infrastructure growth centre, supported by strong economic activity and expanding connectivity. Garner Hotel Ahmedabad Motera is a meaningful addition to our India growth strategy and reflects the appeal of the brand’s model for high-potential markets. The signing also reinforces our commitment to delivering quality, reliable stays that meet the needs of today’s value-conscious travellers.”


**Deepika Arora, Managing Director, United Hospitality Management - India** , said: "We are delighted to continue strengthening our partnership with IHG Hotels & Resorts through the signing of Garner Hotel Ahmedabad Motera. Each new signing reflects the confidence that owners place in the combined strength of IHG's globally recognised brands and UHM's local operating expertise. As our collaboration with IHG continues to grow across India, our focus remains on delivering operational excellence, enhancing long term asset performance and creating memorable guest experiences."


**Mr Prashant Thakkar, Partner Devpriya Buildcon** , added: “Ahmedabad’s economic growth, infrastructure development and rising visitor demand make it an attractive market for branded hospitality. Partnering with IHG Hotels & Resorts and United Hospitality Management to introduce Garner in Motera aligns with our vision of developing future-ready assets for modern travellers.”


Garner Hotel Ahmedabad Motera will feature 40 modern rooms designed for comfort and functionality. The hotel will form part of a mixed-use development with retail, banquet and restaurant facilities, as well as a hospital, creating an integrated offering for guests.


Ahmedabad is one of India’s leading economic and industrial centres, with strength across pharmaceuticals, textiles, information technology, infrastructure and corporate headquarters. Continued investment in sports and transport infrastructure is further supporting demand in the city.


The signing adds Garner to IHG’s Ahmedabad portfolio, which currently includes Crowne Plaza Ahmedabad City Centre and Holiday Inn Express Ahmedabad Prahlad Nagar, with Holiday Inn Ahmedabad in the pipeline.


IHG® currently has 53 hotels operating across six brands in India, including[Six Senses](https://www.sixsenses.com/en) ,[InterContinental Hotels and Resorts®,](http://www.ihg.com/intercontinental/hotels/gb/en/reservation)[Crowne Plaza®,](http://www.ihg.com/crowneplaza/hotels/gb/en/reservation)[voco™ Hotels](https://www.ihg.com/voco/hotels/us/en/reservation) ,[Holiday Inn Resort®](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/our-brands/holiday-inn) and[Holiday Inn Express®](http://www.ihg.com/holidayinnexpress/hotels/gb/en/reservation) , and a strong pipeline of 110 hotels due to open in the next 3-5 years.

## About United Hospitality Management


United Hospitality Management (UHM) is a global leader in hospitality asset development, operationalisation, and management, with over 30 years of luxury expertise and more than USD 3.5 billion in assets under management. The group’s extensive portfolio includes partnerships with world-class brands such as IHG, Marriott, Accor, Hyatt, Wyndham, and Yotel, alongside Bespoke Residences and Holiday Homes. UHM recently expanded its global footprint by entering the Indian market through the acquisition of Rosastays, adding 17 operational holiday homes across the country’s key leisure destinations. Beyond core hotel management, UHM owns and operates a comprehensive lifestyle ecosystem dedicated to amplifying asset value in the hospitality industry. This includes over 20 specialty food and beverage brands, a dedicated wellness division led by its award-winning brand, ‘Serenity – The Art of Well Being’, its sub-brands ‘Pure by Serenity’ and ‘Active by Serenity’. These brands offer a holistic suite of world-class spa treatments, fitness facilities, non-invasive beauty therapies, and exclusive dining concepts, all defined by innovation and exceptional service. With a legacy spanning Europe, the Middle East and India, UHM has built a reputation for operational rigour, distinguished leadership, and strong industry relationships. By consistently developing winning hospitality concepts and maintaining a commitment to excellence, UHM remains a preferred partner for owners and investors worldwide. For more information, visit[unitedhospitality.com](http://www.unitedhospitality.com/) .
